fullPassage: Increased community engagement by professional journalists, on their own, will not solve the problem of making the news more relevant to everyone because traditional news organizations already have abandoned many communities, leaving behind news deserts. In those places, citizens must take up the responsibility for discovering information, holding the powerful accountable, and telling the news for themselves and their neighbors. The democratization of information — through the disruptions caused by computers and the internet — allows citizens to retake control of local news in ways that never have existed before, and it calls them to take greater care in the gathering and dissemination of what they discover or think they know. Journalism, perhaps like never before, belongs to the people rather than to professional journalists, wealthy publishers, or even corporate shareholders. The same technology that has shifted the balance of power toward the people gives them the tools to act as broadcasters and publishers of information essential to their immediate community — and, more critically, to serve as gatekeepers to information for other people around them.

det.korean: ③ 원문은 '되찾다(retake)'인데, '포기하다(surrender)'로 바뀌었다.

det.tip: act as ~ = ~의 역할을 하다. act의 핵심 의미: ① 행동하다 ② 역할을 하다 ③ 연기하다 ④ 법률

questions.passage: Increased community engagement by professional journalists, on their own, will not solve the problem of making the news more relevant to everyone because traditional news organizations already have abandoned many communities, leaving behind news deserts. In those places, citizens must take up the responsibility for discovering information, holding the powerful accountable, and telling the news for themselves and their neighbors. The democratization of information — through the disruptions caused by computers and the internet — allows citizens to retake control of local news in ways that never have existed before, and it calls them to take greater care in the gathering and dissemination of what they discover or think they know. Journalism, perhaps like never before, belongs to the people rather than to professional journalists, wealthy publishers, or even corporate shareholders. The same technology that has shifted the balance of power toward the people gives them the tools to act as broadcasters and publishers of information essential to their immediate community — and, more critically, to serve as gatekeepers to information for other people around them.
questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

Journalism belongs to the people rather than to __________ .
ch: professional journalists, wealthy publishers, or corporate shareholders

det.korean: 언론은 전문 기자, 부유한 출판인, 기업 주주가 아닌 '시민'에게 속한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ professional journalists, wealthy publishers, or corporate shareholders: 원문 일치
❌ ① ordinary citizens: 언론이 속하는 주체이지 대립 대상이 아님
❌ ② computer engineers: 글에 언급 없음
❌ ③ local community volunteers: 글에 언급 없음
det.tip: rather than ~ = ~보다는. 전문가가 아닌 시민에게 언론이 속한다는 핵심 주장.
